Application Data.NAME: Acme Stationery Co.
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Acme Stationery Co. specializes in the retail of stationery and paper products, offering a wide range of items including notebooks, writing instruments, office supplies, envelopes, and specialty papers. Our operations focus on providing high-quality products to both consumers and businesses, ensuring a positive shopping experience through knowledgeable staff and exceptional customer service. We also engage in online sales to cater to a broader audience, aiming to meet the diverse needs of our clientele. Our commitment to sustainability is reflected in our product selection, prioritizing eco-friendly options whenever possible.
